name: sidebar-customizer
description: Customize the visibility of right-hand sidebar elements (Listening Activity, Queue, Connect, Now Playing).

scripts.deploy: npm run build && npm run copy && spicetify config extensions sidebar-customizer.js && spicetify apply
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:dev && npm run copy && spicetify config extensions sidebar-customizer.js && spicetify apply && spicetify enable-devtools
scripts.undeploy: rm -f "$(spicetify path userdata)/Extensions/sidebar-customizer.js" && spicetify config extensions sidebar-customizer.js- && spicetify apply
